title: Tsholofetso e e Buiwang mo godimo ga Malakabe
intro: O eme fa thoko ga molelo wa sekaka fa magala a one a anamisiwa ka kelotlhoko. Baeng ba goroga go tla go kopana mo tidimalong, mme molaetsa o le mongwe fela o bula kgang ya tsholofetso, go gakgamala, le isagwe e e iseng e diragadiwe.
clues: Re ne ra kgabaganya sekgala go fitlha kwa motlhankeng mongwe yo o ikanyegang kwa sekakeng.
Re ne ra kopa gore go gasame magale go baakanyetsa molelo.
Re ne ra bua le mongwe yo o neng a biditse kgabo gore go tsidifale le go babalesega.
Re ne ra tlisa dikgang tsa ngwana yo o sa tswang go tsholwa mo mothong yo o neng a fetile dingwaga tsa go nna le bana.
Re ne ra raya ngwana yo o solofeditsweng leina la Isaka.
Re ne ra tlisetsa Ibrahim dikgang tse di itumedisang tsa morwa, mme dikgang tse di gakgamatsang tseno di ne tsa tlogela Ibrahim a tshega.

trial.label: Teko/Tiragalo
options: Go tlisetsa Ibrahim dikgang tse di itumedisang tsa botsalo jwa ga Isake
Go tlhagisa Lute pele ga batho ba gagwe ba otlhaiwa
Go itsise botsalo jwa ga Yahya go Zakariyya

Go itsise botsalo jwa ga Isa go Maryam
trial.answer: Go tlisetsa Ibrahim dikgang tse di itumedisang tsa botsalo jwa ga Isake

location.label: Elemente ya Botlhokwa

Areka e e kokobetseng mo metsing a morwalela

Thaba ya letsopa le le thatafaditsweng ke letswai
Lere e e yang kwa loaping
location.answer: Molelo o o apeilweng go tswa mo magaleng a a gasameng

outcome.label: Botso
options: Dikgang tse di itumedisang tsa morwa yo o bidiwang Isaac

Taelo ya go aga araka pele ga Morwalela
outcome.answer: Dikgang tse di itumedisang tsa morwa yo o bidiwang Isaac
